warmup_policy: >= 30 trading observations prior to 2019-01-01 strictly reserved for feature warm-up; never evaluated as training or testing period
leakage_safeguards: Chronological partitioning enforced. Rolling indicators look backward only; no future period observations used in scaling. Static universe selection across historical periods inherits survivorship bias, which is documented as an academic research limitation.
legacy_isolation: Legacy 2024 files in yfinance/ and responses/ preserved unchanged. Contract A (legacy 6-month baseline) and Contract B (multi-year OHLCV) are stored independently.
